_meta.notes: MVP test engagement. Two flavor concepts for a new sparkling water line.

concepts.name: CitrusBurst Sparkling Water
concepts.description: CitrusBurst is a premium sparkling water infused with natural citrus oils. Zero calories, zero sweeteners — just crisp bubbles with a bright lemon-lime finish. Available in sleek 12oz slim cans, sold in 8-packs for $6.99. Designed for health-conscious adults who want flavor without compromise.

concepts.name: CitrusBurst Sparkling Water — Vitamin Boost
concepts.description: CitrusBurst Vitamin Boost is a premium sparkling water with natural citrus flavor plus added B-vitamins and electrolytes. Zero calories, zero sweeteners, with functional hydration benefits. Available in sleek 12oz slim cans, sold in 8-packs for $8.49. Designed for active adults who want more from their water.
